intro: This weekend's Gold Coast Greek Festival fills HOTA Parklands with Greek food, dancing and live music — with fireworks over Evandale Lake on Saturday evening — a joyful opener to the season. Sunday also brings the Red Hot Summer Tour to Coolangatta Beach, headlined by a long-awaited reunion of Australian Crawl alongside Men At Work and Birds of Tokyo. The weeks ahead are equally well-stocked: the Pan Pacific Masters Games draw 16,000-plus athletes from 30 nations (6–15 November), World Supercross comes to Cbus Super Stadium on the 21st, and December opens with the Ministry of Sound Summer Dance Festival and Christmas Carol Goes Wrong at HOTA.
topPicksTitle: Top Things To Do This Week (28 Oct – 4 Nov)

topPicks.date: Saturday 31 October – Sunday 1 November · HOTA Parklands
topPicks.name: Gold Coast Greek Festival
topPicks.desc: Two days of Greek food, live music, traditional dancing and celebrity chef demos in HOTA Parklands — with a spectacular fireworks display over Evandale Lake on Saturday evening. George Calombaris, Vikki Moursellas and Anna Polyviou headline the cooking program. Children 13 and under need a child ticket.

topPicks.name: Red Hot Summer Tour — Australian Crawl Reunion
topPicks.desc: Australian Crawl reunite on stage for the first time in 40 years — James Reyne, Simon Binks and David Reyne back together at Coolangatta Beach, with Men At Work, Birds of Tokyo, Eskimo Joe and more on the bill. An outdoor summer concert not to be missed.

topPicks.date: Tuesday 3 November · Gold Coast Turf Club, Bundall
topPicks.name: Melbourne Cup Day
topPicks.desc: The race that stops the nation, celebrated trackside at Aquis Park with live local racing, the Cup broadcast on big screens, and a full day of hospitality and entertainment from 9 am to 5:30 pm.

topPicks.name: HOTA Farmers & Artisan Market
topPicks.desc: A beloved Sunday morning ritual — fresh produce, artisan food, boutique fashion and handcrafted goods from 6 am to 11:30 am in the HOTA precinct, with live music and community acts. Free entry.

events.name: Gold Coast Greek Festival
events.desc: An inaugural weekend festival bringing 10,000 visitors to HOTA Parklands for Greek food, traditional dance, cooking demos from celebrity chefs George Calombaris and Anna Polyviou, live music and a Saturday night fireworks finale over Evandale Lake. The Evzones Collection photography exhibition runs both days.
events.location: HOTA Parklands, Surfers Paradise · 10 min drive

events.name: Red Hot Summer Tour
events.desc: Australian Crawl reunite for the first time in 40 years at this massive outdoor concert on Coolangatta Beach — James Reyne, Simon Binks and David Reyne back together, with Men At Work, Birds of Tokyo, Eskimo Joe, Boom Crash Opera and Killing Heidi's Ella Hooper rounding out the bill.

events.date: Tuesday 3 November · Gold Coast Turf Club
events.name: Melbourne Cup Day
events.desc: The race that stops the nation, celebrated trackside at Aquis Park — live local racing, the Cup on big screens, premium hospitality and trackside entertainment from 9 am to 5:30 pm. Multiple venues across the Gold Coast also host Cup Day events ranging from rooftop cocktail parties to lawn picnics.
events.location: Gold Coast Turf Club, Bundall · 15 min drive

events.name: Pan Pacific Masters Games
events.desc: Over 16,000 athletes from 30+ countries compete across 42 sports in this massive biennial Masters Games — anchored at the Gold Coast Convention Centre in Broadbeach with competition spread citywide. Spectating is free at many venues across the Gold Coast.
events.location: Gold Coast Convention Centre, Broadbeach & citywide · 15 min drive

events.name: HOTA Farmers & Artisan Market
events.desc: A beloved Sunday morning institution — fresh produce, artisan food and drink, boutique fashion, handcrafted goods, live music and community acts at HOTA Parklands from 6 am to 11:30 am. Free entry; on-site cafe and family facilities throughout.
events.location: HOTA Parklands, Surfers Paradise · 10 min drive

events.date: Saturday 21 November · Cbus Super Stadium, Robina
events.name: FIM World Supercross Australian GP
events.desc: Round four of the 2026 FIM World Supercross Championship comes to Cbus Super Stadium — the world's best riders on an indoor dirt track built inside the stadium, with a night format and full support program. One of the Gold Coast's most spectacular sporting nights.
events.location: Cbus Super Stadium, Robina · 20 min drive

events.date: Tuesday 24 November · People First Stadium, Carrara
events.name: Australia v England — 2nd T20I
events.desc: The second match of a five-game T20I series between Australia and England at People First Stadium in Carrara — 6:15 pm local start. Part of England's full summer tour of Australia comprising three ODIs and five T20 internationals.
events.location: People First Stadium, Carrara · 20 min drive

events.name: Ministry of Sound Summer Dance Festival
events.desc: HOTA's biggest ever dance event — three stages, a silent disco under the trees and a headlining orchestral set by the Ministry of Sound Orchestra with conductor Vanessa Perica and Groove Terminator. DJ lineup includes Roger Sanchez, Utah Saints, K-Klass, Seb Fontaine, Braxe + Falcon and DJ Paulette. 18+ event, gates from 4 pm.
events.location: HOTA Parklands, Surfers Paradise · 10 min drive

events.name: Christmas Carol Goes Wrong
events.desc: Mischief's beloved festive comedy comes to HOTA for a strictly limited Gold Coast season before heading to the Sydney Opera House. A chaotically cheerful take on A Christmas Carol from the team behind The Play That Goes Wrong — guaranteed laughter for the whole family.

events.name: HOTA Christmas Twilight Markets
events.desc: A special festive edition of the HOTA community markets — artisan gift stalls, seasonal produce, food and drink vendors and live entertainment in the HOTA parklands as the Christmas season arrives. A lovely evening out ten minutes from the villa.
events.location: HOTA Parklands, Surfers Paradise · 10 min drive
